messages:
nina (AE): Quick sync: Prospect 'MediLoop' wants to replace CompetitorZ with Redwood. Scope: 3-week POC, API/streaming parity, billing mirror for procurement, and clinical intent stability. They need decision before EOM. Any obvious blockers?
rajesh (SE): I'll take the adapter. Their client expects newline-delimited JSON chunks with fields: session_id, intent_label, tokens_delta. Important: they rely on partial "intent_label" updates mid-stream.
claire (SRE): Tokenization delta likely. Recommend a tokenizer parity run on ~400 samples to measure token uplift. Also dual-write canary (48-72h) to validate outputs; adds egress.
otto (Security): Questionnaire flags: SOC2, KMS w/rotation, SAML/SCIM, and optional Private for PHI. For POC they accept hosted + DPA if we can show log redaction and retention policy. If they require VPC peering it's +2 days.
maya (Finance): We can match effective per-token cost via POC credits but won't mirror vendor pricing line-for-line. Propose 45-day credit + 20% onboarding rebate if they commit to a 12-month Dedicated baseline. Need tokens/day estimate.
rajesh (SE): Adapter plan (sketch): proxy endpoint /compat/generate -> call /v1/responses?stream=true, map fields, preserve intent_label in output metadata, and transform our chunks to their newline JSON. Add response-normalizer to ensure keys exist.
claire (SRE): Monitoring: we'll run daily schema-diff job and a small eval harness (200 samples) to compute semantic drift. If drift > threshold, proxy can flip traffic back to CompetitorZ automatically.
otto (Security): I'll start questionnaire draft and include network diagram for Private option. Also will request their compliance contacts for SOC2 artifacts.
nina (AE): Action items: rajesh build adapter PoC by Wed; claire provide tokenizer script + egress/infra estimate by Wed noon; otto draft security answers by Tue; maya write POC credit terms. 30m check-in Fri 9am PT.
rajesh (SE): ack. I'll also push a small comparator: `./bin/compare --gold=competitorz.json --cand=redwood.json --metrics=schema,semantic`
infra-bot: POC sandbox ticket #6120 provisioning in 3 hours.
nina (AE): I'll send the invite and attach the sample bundle. Please add any blockers to the checklist channel. :thumbsup:
